title: Histopathological, molecular and clinical characterization of thyroid cancers.
summary: This study analyzes thyroid tumors under the microscope and on a molecular level. It aims to find out whether specific tissue characteristics are linked to disease progression, such as lymph node involvement or recurrence.

interventions.name: Retrospective cohort: analysis of archived thyroid cancer tissue
Prospective cohort: Analysis of newly obtained thyroid cancer tissue

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- All patients with a differentiated or medullary thyroid carcinoma
- Availability of informed consent
- Availability of tissue samples from the primary tumor
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients with an anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
- Tissue samples exclusively from a recurrence or distant metastases
